evidence.quote: TOOL RESULT (ERROR): Error: non-pending order cannot be modified

observed_facts: The user wanted to modify both the item color and the delivery address of pending order #W4860251.

The policy states: 'Exchange or modify order tools can only be called once.' and 'modify_pending_order_items... will change the order status to pending (items modifed), and the agent will not be able to modify or cancel the order anymore.'
The agent modified the items first at step 39, locking the order status to 'pending (item modified)'.
When the agent attempted to update the address at step 43, the tool failed with an error stating non-pending orders cannot be modified.
inference: Because modifying items permanently locks the order status and prevents further modifications, performing the item modification before the address change was a plan ordering error (Intent-Plan Misalignment) that directly caused the final failure.
needs_verification: Whether the policy allows changing the order of modifications so that address modification could be performed before item modification.
parsed.summary: The agent modified the pending order items before updating the address, which locked the order status according to policy and caused the subsequent address update to fail.
